modules.name: 909 Kick
modules.description: Circuit model of the TR-909 bass drum: reset VCO and waveshaper, pitch sweep (TUNE), click (pulse + noise), with BASE, SWEEP, BEND, SHAPE and AGE

modules.name: 909 Snare
modules.description: Circuit model of the TR-909 snare: two swept VCOs plus filtered noise (TONE, SNAPPY), with RATIO, BALANCE, SWEEP, BEND, SHAPE, COLOUR and AGE

modules.name: 909 Tom
modules.description: Circuit model of the TR-909 low, mid and high toms: swept VCO, waveshaper and skin noise, with SWEEP, BEND, DOUBLE, MUTE and AGE

modules.name: 909 Rim
modules.description: Circuit model of the TR-909 rim shot: three high resonators through a fast transistor VCA and high-pass; RATIO, RING, GATE, SNAP and AGE

modules.name: 909 Clap
modules.description: Circuit model of the TR-909 hand clap: band-passed noise with a burst sawtooth and reverb tail; BURSTS, SPREAD, SNAP, TAIL, BAND and AGE

modules.name: 909 Cymbals
modules.description: The TR-909's 6-bit hat, crash and ride path (clocked DAC, BITS, reconstruction filter, VCA, closed/open choke) around a built-in metal source or your own WAV

modules.name: 909 Circuit Bench
modules.description: All eleven TR-909 voices in one 48 HP module: a screen with the selected voice's circuit, four edit knobs that follow the block you tap, four kit memories, CH chokes OH, own WAVs for hats/crash/ride, per-voice outs and a stereo mix
